ctx.x: You know, it's a program that comes on WNEW -- WDJ, Clinto Utterbach. He's a minister now. Him and his wife.
That's the same Clinton Utterbach because they had the choir. I think he went to join church world or something, and he's on the air. He sounds the same man. Clinton Utterbach. He's a minister now.
